newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end touch lower, lacking direction.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end touch lower, lacking direction.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed a touch lower on Thursday after a lacklustre day in and out of the red in which the market lacked any firm direction.
The Stockholm general index closed 0.07 percent lower at 2029.47 after shares worth 2.8 billion crowns changed hands with some profit taking in the market.
But brokers said there was little to interest the market on Thursday and the main focus was next Tuesday's Federal Reserve meeting in the U.S..
"The market was hardly moving forward at all today and noone wanted to take any large positions," a broker said.
Drugs major Astra closed 1.5 crowns lower at 276 crowns and bluechip Ericsson closed 0.5 crowns higher at 166 crowns.
The best performing sector was banking whose index rose 0.62 percent over the day.

S-E-Banken announced that it had dissolved 300 million crowns of provisions set aside for its Luxonen subsidiary and this would now be included in its third quarter result. It closed 0.5 crowns higher at 57.50 crowns.
Brokers said the market was not expecting any surprises from Sweden's budget due at 0700 GMT Friday.
